title: Interactions & Domain Feature Engineering
interviewAnswer: Feature engineering can expose known structure—ratios, interactions, lags, log transforms or domain aggregations—especially for simpler models. Every feature must be available at prediction time.
why: Interactions & Domain Feature Engineering is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
deepDive: Feature engineering can expose known structure—ratios, interactions, lags, log transforms or domain aggregations—especially for simpler models. Every feature must be available at prediction time. Transform skewed multiplicative scales carefully. Availability/leakage beats cleverness. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: For pricing, include price per unit and price×customer-segment interactions rather than raw price alone.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
followUps: What assumptions or limitations does Interactions & Domain Feature Engineering have?

production: In production, make assumptions explicit, validate on representative slices, compare with a simple baseline and monitor the signals that can drift.
